name: AIGPTImage
tagline: Private AI image studio for production-ready art
description: AIGPTImage is an independent AI image studio for people who need usable visuals, not just experiments. Describe an image, or upload up to 16 reference photos to edit or restyle, and get one to four results in 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3 or 3:4. Output runs from 1K to 4K. The credit cost appears before you generate, and your history stays private. Built-in tools handle background removal, upscaling, old photo restoration and image-to-prompt. The same workspace makes 4–30 second AI videos at up to 1080p with optional audio and no watermark. New accounts get 20 free credits; plans start at $9.99 a month. AIGPTImage is an independent service and is not affiliated with OpenAI.
